patch_description: This variant enhances the best-performing program (score 0.59) by adding two long-range Ising interactions as recommended: ZZ[0,3] and XX[2,7]. This enriches the entanglement structure without increasing the parameter count, addressing the worst-group margin performance issue. The program maintains the efficient 10-parameter structure with mixed Ising and controlled rotation gates, which showed superior generalization (gap of 0.05) and fastest convergence (90 steps). The additional long-range links improve connectivity across distant qubits, which should help separate harder validation samples more robustly while maintaining the shallow circuit regime (depth ≈15).
